faq_heading: Homes near Martha Currie Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Martha Currie Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Martha Currie Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Martha Currie Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Martha Currie Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Bibleway Christian Academy (0.7 km north-east), Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.7 km north-east) and Don Christian Elementary (1.0 km north).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Martha Currie Elementary

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Martha Currie Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 4 secondary, 3 other; 4 independent). The closest is Bibleway Christian Academy, 0.7 km away, and the farthest on this list is Hazelgrove Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.7 km); the nearest secondary school is Lord Tweedsmuir Secondary (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.7 km). Other elementary schools close by: Sunrise Ridge Elementary (0.7 km north-east), Don Christian Elementary (1.0 km north), Cloverdale Traditional (1.2 km west), Hillcrest Elementary (1.5 km north), Latimer Road Elementary (1.7 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Sunrise Ridge Elementary, 0.7 km north-east of Martha Currie Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Martha Currie Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from Martha Currie Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near Martha Currie Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Sunrise Ridge Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 0.7 km north-east of Martha Currie Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
